meta.name: red-team
meta.description: Stress-test a plan, brief or delivery claim against evidence and plausible failure modes. Use when the user asks for a red team or preparation for a consequential decision.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 对方案和交付结论做对抗式挑刺,提前揪出会翻车的地方
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果要在拍板前把重要方案的压力测试做扎实
copy.tagline_en: Pressure-test a plan or delivery claim against evidence before you commit
copy.fit_line_en: For you if a high-stakes decision needs adversarial pressure-testing first

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会针对你给的计划、简报或交付声明做压力测试:对照证据和可能出现的失败模式找漏洞,并诚实报告没跑过的检查或缺失的能力。它只用你提供的上下文,不需要预先建目录或初始化。
howto.when: 当你要求做红队演练,或要为一项重大决策做准备时触发。若由 @fde 调用,会沿用其当前的脱敏信息包和范围,不重新开始设置或追问。

say.text: 帮我红队一下这份上线计划
say.note: 对照证据和失败模式做压力测试

say.text: 这个交付声明站得住脚吗?请做红队
say.note: 检查声明与证据是否匹配

say.text: 为明天的重大决策做红队准备
say.note: 先读任务上下文契约和方法

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude stress-tests a plan, brief or delivery claim against evidence and plausible failure modes, and reports gaps honestly. It works from the context you supply; no engagement folder or initialization is needed.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask for a red team, or when you want preparation for a consequential decision. If called by @fde, it reuses that sanitized packet and scope instead of restarting setup.

say_en.text: Red-team this launch plan for me
say_en.note: Stress-tests it against evidence and failure modes

say_en.text: Does this delivery claim hold up? Red-team it
say_en.note: Checks the claim against the evidence

say_en.text: Red-team prep for tomorrow's big decision
say_en.note: Reads the context contract and method first
